subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported cross-channel pre-processing acknowledgement text contract, or leave acknowledgement UX to channel-specific presence/status implementations?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the solution adds new config or plugin API surface across channel boundaries and overlaps open channel-specific placeholder/presence work.

options.title: Define Cross-Channel Ack Text
options.body: Add a default-off messages.ackText or non-terminal hook contract with scope/per-channel overrides and require schema, docs, tests, and live channel proof.

options.title: Use Channel-Specific Placeholders
options.body: Keep this issue as product context while Telegram, Slack, Discord, and other channels implement their own approved presence or placeholder UX.

options.title: Rely On Existing Presence Cues
options.body: Decline visible text acknowledgements and document typing indicators, ack reactions, and status reactions as the supported responsiveness surface.

recommendation.title: Define Cross-Channel Ack Text
recommendation.body: Add a default-off messages.ackText or non-terminal hook contract with scope/per-channel overrides and require schema, docs, tests, and live channel proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history across the shared messages config, reply lifecycle, and prior issue review for this cross-channel UX gap.
